subject: Will RRO continue to support 32 bit?

messages.author: 1ba7fc139c7eb4c8
messages.subject: Will RRO continue to support 32 bit?
parts:
Seems like 8.0.1 can run in 32 bit windows?  What about 8.0.2, which is only for 64 bit machines right now?  Future versions?

Thanks!

Rob

messages.author: 1ba7fc139c7eb4c8
messages.subject: Re: Will RRO continue to support 32 bit?
parts:
Okay... I'm a bit dense.  Not sure where I got the impression that 8.0.1 was intended for 32 bit machines. 

Was RRO ever intended to support Win32?

Rob

On Wednesday, April 29, 2015 at 9:43:02 AM UTC-7, Robert Balshaw wrote:

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Re: Will RRO continue to support 32 bit?
parts:
Hi Robert,

RRO is built for 64-bit architectures only. It won't work on 32-bit systems.

Cheers,
# David
